default_neutral_probability.description: C parameter: Minimum weighted count for a term to use its calculated probability. Prevents low-count terms from skewing scores.

spam_threshold.description: l parameter: Probability threshold above which a message is classified as spam. Must be between 0 and 1.

max_phrase_length.description: p parameter: Maximum number of words per phrase. Higher values improve accuracy but increase DB size.

cache_size.description: s parameter: Number of terms to keep in the in-memory cache. 0 defaults to 100,000.

non_ascii_replacement.description: a parameter: Character used to replace non-ASCII characters. Use '-' to ignore them (-7 flag logic) or other chars.

special_options.description: o parameter: List of special options to enable (e.g., 'graham', 'honor-status-header', 'tokenized'). If empty, no special options are used.

shared_database_dir.description: D parameter: Path to a shared system-wide database directory used as a baseline. Leave empty if not using a shared DB.

user_database_path.description: d parameter: Path to the user's specific database. Can include type prefix like 'bdb:/var/spamprobe' or 'hash:16:/var/spamprobe'. Leave empty to use default ~/.spamprobe.

scanned_headers.description: H parameter: List of header scanning modes. Use 'normal', 'all', 'nox', 'none', or '+headername' (e.g., '+x-spam-status').

purge_every_n_messages.description: P parameter: Number of messages after which to purge terms with junk count <= 2. Set to 0 to disable periodic purging during processing.
